name: Vowelkit
summary: Vowelkit is a free daily word guessing game made by M Afzaal. Every day there is one five-letter word, the same for everyone, and six tries to find it. Green, yellow and grey tiles show which letters are right, misplaced or missing. Beyond the daily puzzle there are unlimited rounds, word lengths from 3 to 11 letters, a kids mode with easy everyday words, an archive of past puzzles, and a puzzle maker for sending a word to a friend. It runs in any modern browser on phone or desktop, with no app to install and no account needed.
